projectDescription: A Windows desktop app powered by AI to enhance, upscale, and de-noise images and videos using ONNX-based deep learning models.
keyFeatures: AI-powered image and video upscaling (2x and 4x)
Multiple AI models: LVA, RealESR, BSRGAN, RealESRGAN, MSharp, IRCNN
GPU acceleration via DirectML (supports AMD, Intel, NVIDIA)
Automatic image tiling to work within GPU VRAM limits
AI blending/interpolation between original and upscaled output
Privacy-focused: fully offline, no internet connection required
Support for wide range of image and video formats
publicApiSurface: VideoUpscaleTask class — orchestrates video frame extraction, upscaling, and encoding
upscale_image() — upscales a single image file with given settings
upscale_video() — extracts frames, upscales, and encodes video
upscale_orchestrator() — top-level multiprocessing orchestrator for batch upscaling
AI models: LVAx2, RealESR_Gx4, RealESR_Ax4, BSRGANx2, BSRGANx4, RealESRGANx4, MSharpx4, IRCNN_Mx1, IRCNN_Lx1
Supported image formats: jpg, jpeg, png, bmp, tif, tiff, webp, heic
Supported video formats: mp4, webm, mkv, flv, gif, avi, mov, qt, 3gp, mpg, mpeg, vob
Video codecs: x264, x265, h264_nvenc, hevc_nvenc, h264_amf, hevc_amf, h264_qsv, hevc_qsv
